sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Claustrophobia is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "My friend and I were talking about you yesterday. About capable young folks... Then he told me about a couple of soldiers who went down into some catacombs. One panicked and fired off a shot for no reason, the other botched a grenade throw. My friend ended up having to disarm one of his own tripwires on the way back, never got to use it because of this embarrassment. If you don't want to end up making the same kind of mistakes, grab whatever weapon suits you and head into those "dungeons" beneath the Factory. If you can handle your enemies in a place like that, cramped spaces will become your ally."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 5 targets in the basement tunnel network on Factory

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× KEKTAPE duct tape
"Alive and well, I see? Well, now you're the apex predator in those dungeons."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill any 5 targets in the underground on Factory. Only the targets have to be in the area for the kills to count towards the quest.
